chunks: say the ẓuhr (noon) prayers with the people when the shade of the wall of the goats’ pen is equal to the wall.

key_terms.تَفِيءَ: To return or turn back (referring to the sun's shadow moving)
key_terms.مَرْبِضِ: The pen or enclosure (for animals, specifically goats here)

ai.seo_question: When should the noon prayer be performed according to the shadow of the goat pen?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) specifies the start of the Zuhr prayer time as the moment the sun declines from its zenith, using the metaphor of the goat's shadow to denote a short, distinct interval after noon. This ruling emphasizes the importance of communal unity (Jama'ah) in prayer and reflects the practical, observable methods used in early Islamic jurisprudence to determine prayer times without complex astronomical calculations.

en.sayed-ali-raza: say the ẓuhr (noon) prayers with the people when the shade of the wall of the goats’ pen is equal to the wall.
